tools.name: mergeRequest
tools.description: Merge a list of spoke requests to a primary request. Merging a request carries out the following actions – 1. Mark all the tasks of the secondary requests as completed. 2. Lock all the secondary requests. 3. Add all the viewers of secondary requests to primary request.
